parsed.side_detail: The left wall was already close (0.25 m) so I was effectively already on that side, and stepping left kept me out of his path since he was coming toward me on my right; either side would really have done as well.

utterances.message: Hi! Sorry, I can't stop — I'm on my way to the emergency room. I need to keep going!
Oh no, go ahead, don't let me keep you!
